# Kongono Framework v1.2 — Compact LLM Reference (llms.txt)

## Routing & Attributes (`Kongono\Http\Routing\*`)
- `#[Prefix('/api/v1')]`, `#[Get('/items')]`, `#[Post('/items')]`, `#[Put('/items/{id:\d+}')]`, `#[Patch('/items/{id:\d+}')]`, `#[Delete('/items/{id:\d+}')]`
- `#[Middleware(RateLimitMiddleware::class)]`, `#[Idempotent(ttlSeconds: 3600)]`, `#[Can('billing.write')]`, `#[CacheControl(maxAge: 300, public: true)]`
- Controller methods receive typed route params (`int $id`), `Request`, container services, and validated readonly DTOs automatically.

## Typed Validation (`Kongono\Validation\Attributes\*`)
- `#[Required]`, `#[Min(2)]`, `#[Max(120)]`, `#[Between(1, 100000)]`, `#[Email]`, `#[Url]`, `#[In(['a', 'b'])]`, `#[Regex('/.../')]`
- Place attributes directly on `final readonly class` constructor parameters. Invalid input automatically returns HTTP 422 JSON.

## Database & Fail-Closed Multi-Tenancy (`Kongono\Database\*`)
- `$db->table('invoices')->forTenant(new TenantContext($workspaceId))->where('status', '=', 'open')->orderBy('id', 'DESC')->get();`
- `$db->table('invoices')->requireTenant('workspace_id')` throws `DatabaseException` if `workspace_id` equality filter is omitted.
- Unscoped `UPDATE`/`DELETE` fails closed unless `$allowUnscoped = true`.

## Security (`Kongono\Security\*`)
- `SafeHttpClient(allowedHosts: ['api.stripe.com'], allowPlainHttp: false, allowPrivateIps: false)` -> `admitTarget($url)` / `request(...)`
- `Encryptor($key, previousKeys: [$oldKey])` -> `encrypt($plain, $aad)` / `decrypt($cipher, $aad)`
- `Totp` -> `generateSecret()`, `generateRecoveryCodes()`, `code($secret)`, `verify($secret, $code)`, `provisioningUri(...)`
- `SignedUrl($key)` -> `temporary('/path', 3600, ['id' => 1])` / `verify($pathWithQuery)`
- `TokenSigner($key)` -> `sign($claims, 3600)` / `verify($token)` / `generateCsrfToken($sessionId)`
- `PasswordHasher` (Argon2id) -> `hash($pw)` / `verify($pw, $hash)`
- `Principal` + `Gate::authorize($principal, 'capability')`
- `SecretScrubber::scrub($text)` / `SecretScrubber::scrubArray($array)`

## Views (`.kgn.html`)
- `{{ $escaped }}`, `{!! $slot !!}`, `@extends('layouts/app')`, `@section('content')...@endsection`, `@yield('content')`
- `@if`/`@elseif`/`@else`/`@endif`, `@foreach`/`@endforeach`, `@forelse`/`@empty`/`@endforelse`
- Components: `<x-card title="Static" :tag="$dynamic">Slot</x-card>` -> `views/components/card.kgn.html` (use plain `&`, never `&amp;`, in component attributes)

## AI, Governance & MCP (`Kongono\Ai\*`, `Kongono\Cli\*`)
- `AiClient::fromEnv()` (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama) -> `ask()`, `chat()`, `chatStream()`, `structured($prompt, Dto::class)`
- `AgentPrincipal(id, role, allowedTools, maxSteps, maxToolCalls, approvalRequiredTools, maxTokens, maxCostUsd)` + `AgentRunner` (pauses with `status: 'awaiting_approval'` on approval-gated tools)
- Built-in CLI: `kongo serve`, `kongo doctor`, `kongo audit`, `kongo deploy:init`, `kongo routes`, `kongo graph`, `kongo openapi`, `kongo mcp`, `kongo optimize`, `kongo work`, `kongo oshie`, `kongo chie`, `kongo hantei`
